use default

class NODE[T](value: T) is
    next: NODE[T]?
    previous: NODE[T]?

    insert_after(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let inserted = NODE[T](value)

        inserted.previous = self
        inserted.next = next

        if let following = next then
            following.previous = inserted
        fi

        next = inserted

        inserted
    si

    let cursor: NODE[T]? mut = first

    while let node = cursor do
        yield node.value
        cursor = node.next
    od

    let cursor: NODE[T]? mut = last

    while let node = cursor do
        yield node.value
        cursor = node.previous
